outputs.explanation: Panel A includes bar graphs quantifying band intensity (mean ± SD) for nuclear, cytosolic, and mitochondrial fractions. These are bar charts of averaged data, but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points (dots) are overlaid despite N=4 replicates being reported.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrographs; it contains no plots of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot comparison across purification methods with no accompanying quantification plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a western blot (proteinase protection assay) with no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
